display.purpose: Page headline on the header strip; closing panel heading.

title.purpose: The name on a strip; lane and field names.

figure.purpose: Literal file names and numerals shown large, in real case.

statement.purpose: One-line claim beside a tab in a ruled list.

label.purpose: Break strips, navigation, footer, step counter.

lede.purpose: Paragraph under the display headline; section intros.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single curve for every entrance and state change.

motion.name: deal
motion.value: 720ms ease-out; translateX(7%) + clip-path inset from the right; stagger 70ms on load (after 120ms), 80ms on scroll
motion.purpose: Strips, lanes and list rows arriving on the board.

motion.name: drop
motion.value: 620ms ease-out; translateY(-18%) + clip-path inset from the bottom; stagger 80ms
motion.purpose: Cells: field cells and filename segments.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: 800ms (900ms for the page headline) ease-out; translateY(0.35em) + clip-path; lede and actions delayed 180ms
motion.purpose: Headings and numbered steps rising through a clip.

motion.name: rule
motion.value: 900ms ease-out; scaleX(0) to 1 from the left
motion.purpose: The top rule of a ruled list or step list drawing in.

motion.name: job-move
motion.purpose: The job strip travelling between lanes.

motion.name: job-beat
motion.value: 2600ms linear, 3px red line scaleX along the strip's bottom edge; starts 900ms after the lanes are 60% in view
motion.purpose: Progress of each self-played step; stops for good on the first button press and pauses off screen.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no .motion class, no autoplay, no transitions, view-transition animations off, scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: Everything is visible and static under prefers-reduced-motion or without JavaScript.

narrative.overview:
The interface is a film production stripboard: a warm black vinyl board, thin aluminium rails, and matte card strips laid edge to edge. Every piece of content is a strip or a cell on a strip. A strip has a colour that says which folder it belongs to, a name in extra-condensed capitals, and fields separated by hairline rules. Black break strips with white capitals divide the board into groups. Nothing floats, nothing glows, nothing is rounded into a card.

Density is that of a working board rather than a brochure: full-width rows, 3px of board showing between strips, text set close to its rule. Space is spent between sections, not inside strips. The page alternates the dark board and a single off-white card surface, and ends on one red panel that holds the action.

The system was written to refuse the dark gradient product page with a glowing timeline mock-up. It has no gradients, no imagery, and no raster assets; the board itself is the picture.
keyCharacteristics: One material: flat matte strips on a near-black board, separated by 3px gaps and 3px aluminium rails.
Six card colours, one per folder, always with the same dark ink on top.
Red means the action and nothing else.
Extra-condensed capitals name things; a plain humanist sans explains them.
Hairline rules divide a strip into fields, the way a real strip is ruled.
Motion deals strips onto the board; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Red Is The Action Rule
rules.body: Red appears only where the visitor acts or where the action is in progress: the action button, the repository cell, the closing panel, the job's progress line. It is never a folder colour, never an accent on a heading, never a status.

rules.name: The Folder Colour Rule
rules.body: A card colour names a folder. Blue is References, green is Approved Videos, white is Editing Style, pink is Brand Kit, yellow is Raw, orange is Exports. A colour is never reused for decoration or for a second meaning.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Every card colour carries Strip Ink text. The six colours were chosen light enough for it; no strip takes white text.

rules.name: The Capitals Name, Sentences Explain Rule
rules.body: Extra-condensed capitals are for the name of a thing on the board: a folder, a section, a field, an action. Anything that explains is Sofia Sans in sentence case. Condensed type never runs past one or two lines.

rules.name: The Exact Name Rule
rules.body: A literal file or folder name keeps its real case and punctuation, even at figure size (`podcast-ep12`, `_9x16`, `Raw/2026-11-podcast-ep12/`). Uppercasing is for labels, never for something the visitor will type.

rules.name: The Only What Moves Is Lifted Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this can be picked up": the action button and the travelling job strip. Fixed strips, panels, tabs and cells never take one.

dos: **Do** build every new block as a strip, a break strip, or a set of cells on the board grid, edge to edge, with 3px gaps and 3px Aluminium rails.
**Do** keep each folder on its colour everywhere: blue References, green Approved Videos, white Editing Style, pink Brand Kit, yellow Raw, orange Exports.
**Do** set all text on a card colour in Strip Ink, and supporting text on card in Soft Ink.
**Do** keep red for the action: one red button per view, plus the repository cell and the closing panel.
**Do** name things in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed capitals at weight 800 and explain them in Sofia Sans at 400, capped in `ch`.
**Do** show literal file and folder names in their real case, in monospace within text or in Figure type when they are the subject.
**Do** separate fields with a 1px hairline of Strip Ink at 40% and a 1.5rem inset.
**Do** bring strips in with deal, drop or rise on the single ease-out curve, once, and leave them visible when motion is reduced.
donts: **Don't** use gradients, glows, or a product or timeline mock-up; the board is the image.
**Don't** round a strip, cell, tab or panel. Only the action button has a radius (2px).
**Don't** put a shadow on anything fixed. Only the action button and the travelling job strip are lifted.
**Don't** use red for a folder, a heading accent or a status, and don't use a folder colour for decoration.
**Don't** put white text on a card colour.
**Don't** wrap content in a centred max-width container or float it as a card with space all round; strips run full width.
**Don't** set running text in the condensed face, or uppercase a file name.
**Don't** fade things in; entrances are clipped and travel a short distance.
